cells.why: At a 4,096 cap most Think-SFT samples are cut; sampling-m02 says a cut casts no vote, so any short finished answer (about 95 % right at low coverage, result-b006f5) wins outright and the vote sits near pass@4 of the short answers, about 33 of 110 against about 18 for one sample. f2-m01 says hard328 solutions need 6,000-14,000 tokens and short samples never reach them, so a vote over short samples only re-finds the easy problems one short sample already reaches: about the single count plus a few, 25.
